title: MZ Parameters Not Showing after Renaming File

posts.author: Zetu
posts.body:
I renamed my .js file, and ever since then, none of the parameters are showing up, even for other plugins. I'm posting the top part of the plugin below just in case. I've seen by google search that this can mess up things, but never found a solution. For some reason, they also don't work in a new game, and I've even tried random plugins online that don't work either.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
The plugin filename is necessary to get it's plugin parameters.
You can check the Plugin Manager class and the $plugins objects to know better.
The way you get a plugin parameter is the following:
PluginManager.parameters("Your Plugin Name here")
The point is, what you posted is not helpful for us to find a solution. You need to show how are you retrieving the plugin parameters on your code.
Besides that, as soon as you hit playtest, press F12 and go to the CONSOLE tab to see if there is any errors there. Send a screenshot of this CONSOLE tab. Maybe an error is happening and it is preventing your plugin and others to "load".

posts.author: inc0der
posts.body: For future reference, the semi colons can't appear again after the opening comment block /*: because it breaks RPG Maker's parser. Your plugin commands, params and help section all need to be inside the first comment block. Structs are designed to be outside the first comment block.
